links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified AAOS, NASS and AANS spine patient-education materials (paired comparison of readability scores)
links.outcome: Readability of spine patient-education materials (FKGL, SMOG Index, language complexity, passive voice)
links.effect: Mean FKGL fell from 10.2 ± 2.6 (original) to 6.6 ± 1.3 after ChatGPT-4o revision (p < 0.05). SMOG Index, language complexity and passive voice use also improved. Test-retest ICC was 0.91 to 0.98.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o generated articles with a significantly reduced mean FKGL of 6.6 ± 1.3 (p < 0.05).

design_hint: reading-level constraint on LLM-generated patient materials
